content.title: New York City Construction Collapse Kills at Least 8, Injures 18
content.caption: A three-storey residential building collapsed in Brooklyn, New York, killing at least two children and six adults, injuring 18 others.

slides.heading: New York City Construction Collapse Kills at Least 8, Injures
slides.text: A three-storey residential building collapsed in Brooklyn, New York, killing at least two children and six adults, injuring 18 others.

slides.heading: Rescue Efforts
slides.text: Rescue crews continue to search for survivors in the rubble of the collapsed building.

slides.heading: Incident Details
slides.text: The collapsed building was perched at the edge of a lot where another one-storey building had been torn down for a construction project.
